name: mission-control-private
description: Private ChatGPT task staging for Mission Control, with authenticated Supabase MCP tools and WordPress dashboard handoff.

interface.longDescription: Capture and review tasks by project, chat, and Working/Done/On Ice/Deprecated status. Uses owner-scoped Supabase staging and links to the private WordPress dashboard. Does not automatically enumerate ChatGPT history or write to the canonical vault.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Mission Control, verify my connection, and show my staged tasks.
